subject: Bar chart - order of x axis factors

messages.author: 428590d44d600401
messages.subject: Bar chart - order of x axis factors
parts:
Hi all,

Can anyone give me advice on how to set the order in which x axis
factors are displayed? The default appears to be alphabetical from
left to right.

Here is my code:

dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)
p <- ggplot(df3, aes(colour=age, y=latency, x=playback))
p + geom_point() + geom_errorbar(limits, width=0.2) + theme_bw () +
scale_colour_grey(start=0.1, end=0.5)


I'd like to organize by hand the order in which 'playback' appears on
the x axis.

Thanks!

Tonya

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: Bar chart - order of x axis factors
parts:
Hi Tonya,
The order is determined by the factor levels of playback. See ?factor
and perhaps ?reorder for details on how to set factor levels.

Best,
Ista
